content: Aḥsab n řgens d lɛiqab
Tuɣa yarɣa weɣḍab n SIDI ɛawed x Israil. Netta issekkar Dawud xasen, inna: “Uyur ad tḥesbed Israil d Yahuda!”
Inna ujeǧid i Yuwab, akumandar n řɛeskar, wenni tuɣa ɣares iǧan: “Ekk marra tiqebbař n Israil, zi Dan ař Bi’r-Sebɛa, sedd řgens maḥend necc ad ssneɣ řqedd n iryazen n řgens.”

Xenni inna Yuwab i ujeǧid: “Ad yarni SIDI, AREBBI nnec, aṭṭas i řgens-a am mammec ǧan nitni řexxu, ɛad mya n tseqqar am mammec ǧan nitni řexxu, u ejj ad ẓarent tiṭṭawin n sidi inu ujeǧid aya. Maca i umi iwca sidi inu ajeǧid taynit i tmesřact-a?”
Maca awař n ujeǧid ijhed x Yuwab u x ikumandaren n řɛeskar, uca iffeɣ Yuwab ak-d ikumandaren n řɛeskar, yaggʷej x wudem n ujeǧid ḥima ad isedd řɛeskar n Israil.
Nitni ẓwan L’Urdun u wtin iqiḍan nsen ɣar uɣezdis afusi n tendint n Ɛaruɛir tenni ɣar řwesṭ n teɣzart n yeɣzar n Jad, uca uyuren xenni ɣar Yaɛzir.
Usin-dd di Jilɛad u di Taḥtim-Ḥudci. Xas uca usin-dd ɣar Dan-Yaɛan u ɣar jjwayeh n Ṣidun.
Uca usin-dd ɣar tendint n Ṣur i ifaryen s iɣebřawen u ɣar marra tneddam n Iḥiwiyyen d Ikenɛaniyyen, Ɣar uneggar iwḍen nitni ɣar ljanub n Yahuda di Bi’r-Sebɛa.
Ammu kkin nitni marra tammurt u awarni ɛdun tesɛa n iyuren d ɛicrin n wussan usin-dd ɣar Urcalim.
U Yuwab iwca i ujeǧid řqedd n řeḥsab n řgens. Di Israil tuɣa dayes temn-myat-ařef n yeryazen imeḥḍen inni izemmaren x ssif u xemsa-myat-ařef n yeryazen tuɣa aten zi Yahuda.
Maca uř n Dawud ibda ad ireddu as awarni iḥseb řgens u Dawud inna i SIDI: “Necc xḍiɣ xak aṭṭas s min ggiɣ. A SIDI, kkes řexxu řmuɛṣiyyet x umsexxar nnec, maɣar necc ggiɣ tubbuheřya tameqqrant.”
Umi Dawud ikkar ɣar tuffut, imsar, aqa yusa-dd awař n SIDI i unabi Jad, amwařaw n Dawud, inna:
“Uyur, siweř i Dawud: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Ad ac dd-ssarseɣ třata n tmesřayin. Ixḍar ict zzaysent uca ad ac tt ggeɣ.’”

Yusa-dd Jad ɣar Dawud, ixebbar i-t, inna as: “Ma ad iwḍa sebɛa n iseggʷusa n řaẓ x temmurt nnec? Niɣ texsed ad tarewřed třata n iyuren zzat i wudem n řɛedyan nnec u netta ad cek iḍfar? Niɣ texsed ad yiři ṭṭaɛun di temmurt nnec? Xenni řexxu, ssen min i ɣa tixḍared u xzar, min dd ɣa arreɣ ɣar wenni d ayi dd-issekken.”
Xenni inna Dawud i Jad: “Necc ttwaḥṣareɣ aṭṭas. Ejj aneɣ ad newḍa deg ifassen n SIDI, maɣar arreḥmet nnes temɣar, maca war xseɣ ca ad wḍiɣ deg ifassen n iwdan.”
Xenni issiweḍ SIDI ijj n ṭṭaɛun x Israil, zi tuffut ař ijj n řmijař ittwaggen. Mmuten sebɛin-ařef n yeryazen n řgens zi Dan ař Bi’r-Sebɛa.

Umi isswiẓẓeḍ lmalak afus nnes x Urcalim, ḥima ad iɣḍeř tandint deg uḍeyyeɛ, indem SIDI x tuɛeffna, inna i lmalak i iggur ad iɣḍeř řgens deg uḍeyyeɛ: “Cfa, sehwa afus nnec řexxu!” Tuɣa lmalak n SIDI ittaweḍ ɣar unedrar n Uyabusi Arawna.

Umi Dawud iẓra lmalak wenni iwtin řgens, issiweř Dawud ak-d SIDI, inna: “Xzar, necc xḍiɣ u necc, wah necc ggiɣ řmuɛṣiyyet, maca uǧi-ya, min ggin? Ejj ad yiři ufus nnec i tecti ɣari d ɣar taddart n baba.”
Aɛalṭar x wendrar n Arawna
Deg wass nni beɛda yusa-dd Jad ɣar Dawud, inna as: “Geɛɛed, sbedd ijj n uɛalṭar i SIDI x unedrar n Uyabusi Arawna.”
Dawud igeɛɛed ɛlaḥsab awař n Jad, am mammec t yumur SIDI.
Arawna iceyyeɛ u iẓra ajeǧid ak-d imsexxaren nnes usin-dd ɣares. Xenni yuyur Arawna ɣar barra, ibendeq zzat i ujeǧid s uɣembub nnes ɣar temmurt.
Arawna inna: “Mayemmi i dd-yusa sidi inu ajeǧid, ɣar umsexxar nnes?” Dawud inna: “Ḥima ad xak sɣeɣ andrar ḥima ad bniɣ din ijj n uɛalṭar i SIDI, maḥend ad tbedd tecti di řgens.”

Xenni inna Arawna i Dawud: “Ejj sidi inu ajeǧid ad iksi u ad iwehheb min d as ittɣiř d lemliḥ di tiṭṭawin nnes. Xzar aqa din ifunasen d tfunasin i tɣarṣt n wecmaḍ u ksi tiřwiḥin itteḥřuǧuḍen i usarwet d řeḥwayej n ifunasen d tfunasin d akeccuḍ i tmessi.
Aya marra, a ajeǧid, ad ac iwc Arawna i ujeǧid.” Ɛawed inna Arawna i ujeǧid: “Iři ad dd-tased cek x řxaḍar ɣar SIDI, AREBBI nnec!”

Maca ajeǧid inna i Arawna: “Lla, maɣar necc xseɣ ad xak t sɣeɣ s ttaman nnes ikmeř, maɣar necc war ttwehhbeɣ i SIDI, AREBBI inu, tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ i war isekkwin walu.” U Dawud isɣa andrar d ifunasen d tfunasin i xemsin ciqlu n nnuqart.
Dawud ibna din ijj n uɛalṭar i SIDI uca issgeɛɛed din tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ d tewhibin n řɣiǧet. Ammu ittwasseṣřeḥ SIDI x temmurt s tẓaǧit yuǧɣen u tᵉttwassbedd tecti di Israil.
